description: This file defines API route handlers for the exam environment in a Fastify server, including endpoints for fetching exams, creating attempts, validating tokens, and retrieving attempt details. It manages exam attempts, moderation, and access control, integrating with Prisma ORM and JWT for authentication.

methods.name: tokenMetaHandler
methods.description: Verifies an exam environment authorization token, checks its validity, and returns its expiration date if valid.

methods.name: postExamGeneratedExamHandler
methods.description: Generates an exam for the user, creating an attempt record, and returns the exam data.

methods.name: postExamAttemptHandler
methods.description: Handles updates to an existing exam attempt, validating timing and correctness, and updating the database.

methods.name: getExams
methods.description: Retrieves public info about all exams, including whether the user can take each exam based on prerequisites and attempt history.

methods.name: getExamAttemptsHandler
methods.description: Fetches all exam attempts owned by the authenticated user, including completed attempts.

methods.name: getExamAttemptHandler
methods.description: Fetches a specific exam attempt by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getExamAttemptsByExamIdHandler
methods.description: Fetches all attempts for a specific exam ID owned by the user.

methods.name: getExamChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves relations for a challenge or exam, such as associated questions or metadata.
